newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atok shares rise frozen after 48 pct surge.
newsitem.headline: Atok shares rise frozen after 48 pct surge.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange stopped further rise in the share price of Atok-Big Wedge Co Inc after it rose by 7.5 centavos, or 48 percent, to 23 centavos in early trade, an exchange official said.
The bourse automatically freezes further rise in share prices if a rise nears 50 percent, or if it drops by 45 percent in a single day.
Brokers said the buying was purely speculative play. Company officials were not immediately available to comment.
The exchange said it was drafting a letter asking the company to explain the sudden rise in its share price.
Atok used to be a mining firm which is now a holding firm. Its interests are still largely in mining but the company has been trying to diversify its portfolio.
